# p0_aws_s3_audit_logs (Resource)

Writes P0 audit events to an Amazon S3 bucket as gzipped files, one JSON event per line, about every 15 minutes.

To install:
1. Create a `p0_aws_s3_audit_logs_staged` resource for the bucket.
2. Create the `P0RoleIamS3Writer` role in the bucket's AWS account. It must trust P0's service account (`service_account_id` from the staged resource) and allow `s3:PutObject` on the bucket's objects. See the example.
3. Create this resource with the same `id`, `account_id`, `region` and `partition`. P0 checks the role's policies and writes one test file to `p0-install-check/` in the bucket.

Only one `p0_aws_s3_audit_logs` resource is supported per P0 organization.

For the full install steps, see [Amazon S3 (audit logs) setup](https://docs.p0.dev/integrations/siem-integrations/amazon-s3-audit-setup).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}
data "aws_region" "current" {}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "p0_audit_logs" {
  bucket = "p0-audit-logs"
}

resource "p0_aws_s3_audit_logs_staged" "example" {
  id         = aws_s3_bucket.p0_audit_logs.bucket
  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  region     = data.aws_region.current.name
}

# The role P0 assumes to write to the bucket. Its trust policy and inline policy
# must match these exactly, or P0's check fails.
resource "aws_iam_role" "p0_s3_writer" {
  name = "P0RoleIamS3Writer"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect    = "Allow"
      Principal = { Federated = "accounts.google.com" }
      Action    = "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
      Condition = {
        StringEquals = {
          "accounts.google.com:aud" = p0_aws_s3_audit_logs_staged.example.service_account_id
        }
      }
    }]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "p0_s3_writer" {
  name = "P0RoleIamS3WriterPolicy"
  role = aws_iam_role.p0_s3_writer.name
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid      = "P0CanVerifyOwnRole"
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = ["iam:GetRole", "iam:GetRolePolicy"]
        Resource = aws_iam_role.p0_s3_writer.arn
      },
      {
        Sid      = "P0CanWriteAuditFiles"
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = "s3:PutObject"
        Resource = "${aws_s3_bucket.p0_audit_logs.arn}/*"
      },
    ]
  })
}

# Checks the role and writes one test file to p0-install-check/ in the bucket.
resource "p0_aws_s3_audit_logs" "example" {
  id         = p0_aws_s3_audit_logs_staged.example.id
  account_id = p0_aws_s3_audit_logs_staged.example.account_id
  region     = p0_aws_s3_audit_logs_staged.example.region
  depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy.p0_s3_writer]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The ID of the AWS account that owns the bucket. P0's AWS integration must be installed for this account.
- `id` (String) The name of the S3 bucket P0 writes audit files to. The name only, not an ARN or `s3://` URL.
- `region` (String) The AWS region the bucket is in, for example `us-west-2`

### Optional

- `partition` (String) The AWS partition the account is in, `aws` or `aws-us-gov`. Defaults to `aws`.

### Read-Only

- `state` (String) This item's install progress in the P0 application:
	- 'stage': The item has been staged for installation
	- 'configure': The item is available to be added to P0, and may be configured
	- 'installed': The item is fully installed
